port.description: TCP port the Grafana web UI listens on

prometheusUrl.description: URL of the Prometheus to query, e.g. the monitor/prometheus block's VIP: http://10.0.0.50:9090

adminPassword.description: Password for Grafana's admin user; applied when Grafana first creates its database

anonymousViewer.description: Let anyone who can reach the port view dashboards without logging in
